dialog.title: Import from YouTube
dialog.description: Paste a video watch URL. The video and its subtitles will be downloaded into your library automatically.
dialog.noSubtitle: No subtitles found; generate AI subtitles in the player

settings.title: YouTube Import
settings.description: Paste a YouTube link to download the video and subtitles into your library for offline study.
settings.loadFailed: Failed to load settings. Please try again.
settings.enableDescription: Hides the home entry and rejects new imports when off; running tasks are unaffected. The yt-dlp component (~40MB) is downloaded automatically on first use.
settings.cookiesDescription: Proxy exit IPs often trigger YouTube's bot check. Configure a cookies.txt (Netscape format, exported via the Get cookies.txt LOCALLY extension from a signed-in browser) to bypass it; leave empty to download without cookies.
